apps.title: Merry Christmas Color
apps.summary:
🎄 Someone left a mysterious gift beneath the Christmas tree—but the wrapping gives nothing away. What could be inside?
Add the colors and uncover the Christmas surprise. Merry Christmas Color is a relaxing coloring game for adults, filled with festive art, cozy holiday pictures, and peaceful coloring moments. 🎁✨

🎅 Step Into a Christmas World Made for You
What makes Christmas feel special to you—the tree, the lights, the snow, the gifts, or that warm little moment by the fireplace?
Open your Christmas coloring book and explore a festive collection of holiday pictures:
• Santa Claus, reindeer, snowmen, and cheerful Christmas characters
• Christmas trees, ornaments, wreaths, stockings, and bells
• Wrapped gifts, a surprise present, candy canes, gingerbread, and festive treats
• Cozy cottages, glowing fireplaces, and decorated rooms
• A snowy village, fresh snow, winter streets, and peaceful winter landscapes
• Christmas parties, warm Christmas light, sparkling lights, and heartwarming holiday moments
Look closely for the little details too—a favorite ornament on the tree, a golden bell by the door, fresh snow on the village roofs, or a present waiting beside Santa Claus.
Choose a bright Christmas celebration or a quiet snowy evening—every picture brings a different holiday mood to color. From Santa and gingerbread to a village glowing under Christmas light, your coloring book becomes a growing collection of festive art you can return to anytime.

🎨 Easy Color by Numbers, Satisfying from the First Tap
No drawing skills. No complicated tools. No pressure.
Choose a Christmas picture, follow the numbered areas, and tap the matching colors into place.
• Follow easy number guides
• Tap to color each matching area
• Watch festive details appear color by color
• Complete every picture at your own pace
• Enjoy visible progress with every tap
You don’t need brushes or pencils, and there’s no need to draw or paint by hand. The simple design of this color by numbers game makes coloring by number easy to start and satisfying to finish.
Each tap brings your Christmas art closer to completion, turning numbered spaces into a finished festive painting.

Whether you enjoy adult coloring books, relaxing games, art games, or games for adults, Merry Christmas Color gives you a simple way to unwind with Christmas pictures and peaceful coloring.

apps.title: Aniimo
apps.summary:
Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. On the vast continent of Idyll, you'll encounter countless unique creatures known as Aniimo. Twine with them and experience the beauty of this world from a completely new perspective and with new abilities.
You can also travel to a metropolis floating in the sky, where you'll meet other Pathfinders, share stories, and engage in thrilling competitive battles. Choose your Aniimo and embark on an epic journey - one full of exploration, discovery, and adventure!

Seize every chance to capture and collect Aniimo to your heart's desire!

When embarking on an adventure on Idyll, anyone you meet can become a companion! Catch Aniimo using Aniipods, set traps and time your catch perfectly - enjoy the thrill and uncertainty of every moment! Unique Aniimo will appear according to the environment, weather, phenomena and time of day. Most Aniimo can evolve, making collecting and discovering Aniimo even more exciting.

Twine with Aniimo to feel the world like they do

On your journey of adventure you can Twine with Aniimo and essentially become any Aniimo that you collect. Use the Aniimo’s skills to solve puzzles, win battles and overcome challenges! Twine with Aniimo, to see the world from a brand new perspective.

Jump into the adventure and enjoy exploring an expansive open world

The continent of Idyll is expansive and alive with beauty and the perfect setting to capture, to Twine, to find answers and for the Aniimo to reach their full potential. Challenge, race, discover... immersive exploration ensures every step of the journey is engaging. Whether you're gliding, diving, burrowing... you can step foot anywhere.

Join exciting real-time challenges with Aniimo

In the vast world of Aniimo, every real-time challenge is full of unknowns and surprises. The PVEVP mode "Egg Heist" allows you to join a 3-player team anytime to engage in real-time searches and battles in the Lost Isles.
Whether you're solo, multiplayer, adventuring, battling, or simply looking to quickly become stronger, here, every challenge is real and instantaneous!

Enjoying camping and roadtrips with your friends

Each Pathfinder now owns a personal RV on the vast continent of Idyll, parked at a campsite in this open world, where they can meet and interact with other players. When you return to Homeland with your RV, you can plant crops, build decorations, and freely arrange your space with Aniimo to transform the entire Homeland into a warm, fun, and interactive immersive paradise.

apps.title: Infinite Light Years
apps.summary:
「Infinite Light Years」is a real-time strategy space warfare game. In a universe consumed by war, you will command your own fleet and journey across dangerous galaxies. Navigate the conflicts between powerful factions and embark on an unforgettable adventure among the stars.

Unbound Warfare, Real-Time Strategy — The Stars Await Your Command
Experience an authentic RTS space battle. Take direct control of your starships, master their movements, and deploy tactical weapons at the perfect moment. Whether you engage head-on, strike from the flank, coordinate a concentrated assault, or split your forces for guerrilla tactics, every battle is shaped by your strategy.

Countless Weapons, Endless Combinations — Research Your Way to Victory
Dive deep into strategic preparation, customize your fleet formations, and create the perfect weapon configurations. Shatter shields with kinetic weapons, tear through armor with lasers, or use EMPs and jump technology to break into enemy formations and strike from within. Outsmart your enemies through unexpected strategies.

Original Starships, Tactical Formations — Command Fleets Across the Galaxy
Encounter powerful warships from countless factions, including the Lark Empire, Silicon Lifeforms, Higher Dimension, and more. From agile frigates and powerful cruisers to massive carriers, every class has its own unique design, combat role, and weapon system. With beautifully crafted starship models, collecting becomes a rewarding experience.

Explore the Stars, Discover the Unknown — Secrets Beyond the Light Years
Set out to explore countless planets, each with their own unique environments and mysteries.
Dynamic events will unfold throughout your journey, bringing unexpected encounters, hidden opportunities, or dangerous challenges.

Focused Fire, Swift Victory — Galactic Battles Begin Instantly
Here, every battle is fast-paced and designed to be completed in a short time. There’s no need to constantly monitor your fleet — simply enter the game and jump straight into an intense battle. With no limits on your battles, you can say goodbye to the pressure of chasing progress. Gaming should be free and unrestricted. We refuse to turn play into a daily chore.

Wield the mighty boltgun and an arsenal of iconic Warhammer 40,000 weapons. Tear through cultists, traitors and daemons with explosive gunplay, relentless movement and the fury of an old-school shooting game.

Step into the power armour of Malum Caedo and bring the Emperor’s wrath to enemies of the Imperium. Face overwhelming hordes, towering war machines and the horrors of Chaos.

Move fast, fire faster and master responsive first-person shooting inspired by classic ’90s action games. Every battlefield rewards aggression, exploration and overwhelming firepower.

apps.title: Battleburg
apps.summary:
DRIVE YOUR CASTLE. PROTECT YOUR PEOPLE.
Welcome to Battleburg, a revolutionary Medieval Strategy experience where your stronghold isn’t anchored to the earth—it rolls on massive wheels! Assume the role of Captain and guide your survivors, evolving from a modest caravan into a sprawling, nomadic empire.

【KEY FEATURES】

ONE-FINGER MASTERY: CRUSH THE FRONTLINES
Experience ultimate "mowing" satisfaction! Use a single finger to steer your massive castle, dodging and crushing thousands of enemies with intuitive touch controls. Simple to play, intense to master.

A THRIVING VILLAGE IN MOTION
Your fortress is a sanctuary. Design and manage a fully functional Medieval Village within your castle walls, providing a growing home for your survivors on the move.

EVOLVE YOUR DEFENSES: WOOD TO FORGED IRON
Scavenge resources to reinforce your base. Upgrade from timber to siege-proof armor and install auto-firing ballistas. Watch your humble village evolve into an invincible, gold-plated Iron Titan.

THE ULTIMATE 4X FRONTIER EXPANSION
The world is yours to conquer. Transition from tactical driving to a massive World Map. Scout resources, establish outposts, and engage in deep 4X gameplay. Your kingdom knows no borders.

ALLIANCE WARFARE: THE STEEL MARCH
There is true power in numbers. Align with other mobile fortresses to form an unbreakable "Steel Wall" or execute perfectly timed strikes on rival capitals. Trade resources, coordinate tactics in real-time chat, and seize the throne alongside allies from across the globe.

Will you lead your survivor to glory or let the wilderness reclaim them? Download Battleburg and start your engine today!

apps.title: Age of Spirits
apps.summary:
Long before kingdoms rose and steel was forged, the world belonged to the dark. Beneath a cold canopy of bone and ash, primitive savages huddled around scattered hearth-fires, listening for the whispers of the Old Ones, the ancient wicked gods who hungered for living warmth and dragged the souls of the weak into the underworld. Most clans flickered out before the first dawn. A few endured. And then, the spirits sent a Chief.

You are that Chief, the one whose will guides the people from above the firelight. Though you do not lift the spear yourself, every shaman you awaken bears your command, every villager labors by your decree, and every hearth-fire that burns is kindled because you have decided it should. From the high seat of an isolated tribe at the edge of the dark, you must reclaim wandering savages, summon legendary heroes to lead your warbands, build the first true settlement the Wilds have ever known, and forge a people strong enough to outlive the night.

Age of Spirits is a strategy game of awakening, ritual, and primal resolve. Will you raise tall stones around your hearth-fire and grow your tribe into a city of rites and crafts, or will you march your warbands deep into ancestral grounds to seize what only the bravest can win? • Be Clever — One person sees the word and writes hints, and the others race to see who can guess it first.

• Invisible Ink — Everyone answers the question in secret, then you guess whose answer each one is.

• Ask and Learn — You write the questions, or withdraw them from the bank, and answer each other's questions.

🤝 Play with the gang on one device — One phone is passed around, no code or room required.

• Spy • Detective and Accused • Be Clever

📱 Play with your friend — You play on your phone and they play on theirs.

• Catch Hamasa — Each person chooses a word for the other, and you have to spell it out letter by letter before Hamasa gets hanged.

• Word Chain — A chain of 10 words, each pair containing a well-known term, and your friend has to spell it out word by word.

• Word Collection — Scattered letters are presented to both of you, and whoever spells them out first gets the point.

• Be Clever — 10 clues, from general to specific, and whoever spells the word first gets the point.


• Be Clever — 10 clues, from general to specific, and whoever spells the word first gets the point.

• Investigator and Accused — Each hides a word, and you investigate together at the same time.

• Questions and Information — One question and three possible answers are presented to both players. Whoever guesses correctly gets the point.

• Hide Your Money — Each player hides an amount of money, and the other player tries to find it by asking yes or no questions in three attempts.

🤝 Play with a friend on one device — One phone for both of you
• Investigator and Accused · Catch the Moment · Word Series · Be Clever

• Word Series · Catch the Moment · Word Collection · Be Clever · Questions and Information
Each game gives you a title and statistics, and your record is saved on your device for you to try and beat.

✨ Why Guess the Moment?

• No registration required — No email or phone number needed. Your name and avatar, and you're all set.

• A 4-digit code or a QR code—and the room opens in a second.

• Your friend has an iPhone? They can play with you right away in the browser.

• Your internet connection dropped? Come back on the same device, and your place will be the same, and your points will still be counted.

Choose whether you want to play with a group, with a friend, or alone.

Choose a game and create a room—or join with your friend's code.

Everyone chooses their name and avatar, and the host starts.

"Guess Hazar" is a collaboration between HAZZAR Games and Mohamed & Taghreed.

• HAZZAR Games — A small Egyptian team developing games and challenges for friends and for you when you're alone. All in Egyptian Arabic, free, and no registration required.

• Mohamed & Taghreed — Content creators who have been sharing challenges and games with you for a long time, and now they're bringing them to you here in an app to play together.

كل مركز له شرط — جنسية، دوري، نادي. كلكم بتجاوبوا في نفس الوقت، محدش شايف إجابة التاني، والكشف هو اللي بيحكم. أعلى مجموع في الهدف ياخد البطولة.

apps.title: Liquid Vial
apps.summary:
Liquid Vial is a calm, one-finger water sort puzzle. Each tap pours the top layer of one tube into another, and the goal never changes: end every tube holding one clean, single color. No timers, no lives, no punishment for thinking.

HOW TO PLAY • Tap one tube, then tap another to pour. • Pour onto an empty tube or onto the same color only. • Each tube holds four layers; a legal pour moves as much as fits. • Clear the level when every tube is a single pure color.
3,500+ LEVELS, EVERY ONE VERIFIED • 3,586 main levels, each validated by our solver before it ships. • No repeated layouts — every board is normalized and de-duplicated. • Difficulty ramps from 2-4 colors in the first ten levels to 11-12 in the challenge range. • Every level is solvable. If you get stuck, the board is at fault, not you.

HIDDEN COLORS Some tubes hide their true colors and show only what the top layer reveals; pour it out and what was buried appears. A simple sort becomes a test of memory and planning.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY • Winning Streak — chain clears to raise your multiplier and unlock chapters. One slip ends the run. • Daily Challenge — one fixed board for everyone, ranked by moves then time. •

PLAY IT YOUR WAY • One hand, one finger, portrait. The rules take three seconds to learn. • The whole main line plays offline, anywhere. • Music, sound and vibration switch on and off separately. • Interstitial ads never appear in the first five levels and carry a daily cap. • Reward ads are always your choice; skip them and nothing is lost.

apps.title: Boom Crush: 3D Blast Fun
apps.summary:
Welcome to Boom Crush, a cheerful casual game with physics puzzle action. Aim a cannon at unstable towers and watch blocks, crates, and cans move, bounce, and fall in a 3D arena.

Choose a level, inspect the stack, set your cannon angle, and shoot at the weak point. A careful cannon shot can crush a support, trigger a blast, and send the tower into a chain reaction.

Physics Puzzle Challenges

Every physics puzzle has a different layout. Light blocks slide easily, while heavy pieces hold the stack. A low cannon shot may crush the base; a higher cannon shot may reach a protected block. Watch how the first blast changes the physics puzzle before choosing your next cannon move.

Cannon, Crush, and Blast Action

Tap to aim, adjust the cannon, and shoot. A direct cannon shot may smash one block, while a planned cannon launch can create a wider blast. Look for gaps and weak supports.

Objects tip, bounce, break, and crush into one another. A small blast can shift a stack, while a side blast can push a block toward another target. A central blast may open a path for a second crush. Every smash changes the scene. Watch the first smash, plan the next smash, and use a final smash when the stack is ready. One crush can lead to another crush, while a careful blast can prepare the next blast.

One smash can move a block; a second smash can start a blast. Watch the smash before the next smash and adjust your shot.

Colorful Stacks and Simple Controls

Boom Crush uses familiar objects in casual game levels. One physics puzzle may use boxes and crates; another physics puzzle combines cans, jars, and rubber ducks. Use the cannon to move a key block, then let gravity continue the crush. A careful smash can remove one support, while a wider blast can clear a row.

The controls are easy for casual players, but each physics puzzle rewards observation. Replay a level to test another cannon position, compare a low shot with a high shot, and find a cleaner route. An angle change can create a new blast path. If the first smash leaves a block standing, adjust the cannon and try again.

Relaxing Casual Games

Play a quick round or continue through more casual games. Watch the tower lean as pieces smash, slide, and settle. Every crush matters, and each cannon shot can change the result.

For another physics puzzle, adjust the cannon angle. A short cannon shot may crush one block, while a longer cannon launch can start a blast. Let the first crush settle, then choose a second blast or smash. The right cannon move can connect the next crush and smash.

In a physics puzzle, a careful blast can shift the base before a second blast reaches the upper stack. One crush can open a path, one smash can move a block, and another smash can finish the layout. Study the target, plan the blast, and choose the next cannon action.

Can you solve every physics puzzle, manage your cannon shots, and use each blast wisely? Aim at the weak block, start the crush, and enjoy this casual game.

apps.title: Castlevania: 40th Anniversary
apps.summary:
□Story

In medieval Europe, the legend of Dracula is told in frightened whispers in the small country of Transylvania.

Once every century, the prayers of those with evil in their hearts shall resurrect the Dark Lord Dracula. Each time he returns, his dark powers grow stronger than the last.

One night there was a magnificent carnival being held in the bustling city. That night marked the 100th year anniversary of Dracula’s defeat at the hands of the hero Christopher Belmont.

Suddenly, the town was enveloped by dark storm clouds and a bolt of lightning rained down, signaling that Count Dracula and his evil ambitions had returned to the world yet again.

With the Belmont blood running though his veins, the young Vampire Hunter Simon knew that only he could face this evil. Taking up the whip enchanted with miraculous power given to him by his father, Simon hastened towards Dracula’s castle on his own.

□Features

The deep rich Castlevania history that began with this original game.

The fated confrontation between Dracula and unforgettable action hero Simon Belmont that played out with a horrific twist groundbreaking for its time.

The dark vast world of Castlevania that canonized the iconic whip-wielding character moves of Simon Belmont and the classic music tracks.

Intense hard-to-beat action platformer that inspired a long-running and beloved franchise.

Direct port of the original title with visual touchpad and playable offline.

□ Important Notes
・The game will remain playable after its availability on the App Store ends.
・Please see the Terms of Use (Castlevania) available within the app before playing.

apps.title: Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort
apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

apps.title: Pixel Gun 2
apps.summary:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more!

Short matches. Destructible arenas. Wild builds. Non-stop FPS action. Ever-evolving world. A piece of controlled mayhem that fits in your pocket — or takes over your evening. Jump in for a few PvP battles or lose track of time (with no regrets).

Experiment with loadouts, improvise in ever-changing environments, embrace the chaos, and make the most out of the reality-bending Pixelstorm!

EVERY MATCH HITS DIFFERENT
Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The battle arena starts falling apart with every shot fired. Creative builds clash, throwing surprises at everyone involved.

As the PvP match goes on, you evolve too — stacking perks, adapting on the fly, and leaning into whatever the situation demands. Will you end up a life-stealing headshot machine, a melee juggernaut, a speed-running gadgeteer — or something nobody saw coming?

Next time it will be different. And that’s the point.

WRECK HAVOC. MAKE A MESS
Pixel Gun 2 maps are breaking apart — and you’d better take advantage of it.

Use the destructible environment for smart tactical moves or just for the sake of pure fun. No cover is built to last. If something’s in your way — blow a hole through it. If someone’s camping — make a few “architectural adjustments” to their hiding spot.

You’re not here to build. You’re here to destroy. The battlefield keeps changing — and so do your options.

YOUR CHARACTER. YOUR BUILD. YOUR VIBE
Pixel Gun 2 is all about playing your way.

Mix characters, weapons, gadgets, armor, perks, and abilities into builds that feel powerful, clever, aggressive, weird — or all of the above.

Get creative. Break the meta. Find something that just clicks.

CROSS DIMENSIONS. MORE PLATFORMS AHEAD.
Start your journey on mobile, with Pixel Gun 2 coming to PC in the future. Cross-platform play and shared progression are planned, so your progress and rewards can travel with you between devices.
Play now — and stay tuned for PC release news.

THE PIXELSTORM IS RISING
The world of Pixel Gun 2 isn’t about order or stability — it’s about constant change and adaptation.

A strange calamity keeps bending the rules of reality, opening new possibilities (and dangers) over time. New heroes, gear, abilities, seasons, game modes, and even entire worlds appear in this ever-shifting multiverse.

Pixel Gun 2 is a mobile first-person shooter that evolves around — and for — you. Expect the unexpected.

apps.title: Narco Empire
apps.summary:
Pull yourself up from the gutter and take control of the underground in Narco Empire. Step into a raw, cinematic underbelly of secret labs, risky shipments, and bloody turf clashes — every choice about trust, risk, and ambition pushes you from a nobody on the block to a leader people fear.

From corner deals to the throne
Begin with small trades and tough calls. Make allies, collect favors, and turn tiny wins into real standing. As your influence grows, neighborhoods fall under your control, and each decision opens new chances — and new dangers.

Run the underground supply
Hunt down scarce materials across contested blocks and hide workshops that slowly turn into full operations. Close-up, hands-on lab scenes let you sharpen your product and raise its value on the black market. Improve how you work, bring in trusted hands, and scale from cramped benches to full factories.

Plot dangerous smuggling runs
Plan routes, prepare convoys, and react fast when things break down. Send guarded loads through hostile zones, pick stealth or force, bribe contacts, or sabotage rival narco crews — and always watch for checkpoints. Each successful run opens new trade corridors and extends your reach.

Turn goods into clout
Use distribution to build power: run street deals, land big wholesale contracts, and launder dirty cash into a respectable front. Oversee retail chains, pressure or partner with rivals, and plant investments that keep your empire hidden from view.

Keep the crown — and survive
Power draws betrayal. One mistake can wipe everything out. Recruit loyal lieutenants, sharpen your enforcers, and flush out moles before they strike. Diplomacy, threats, and targeted strikes are all in your playbook — but loyalties can flip overnight. Will you rule from the shadows, or become just another name in a police file?

Disclaimer: This game is a work of fiction. All substances, events, and characters portrayed are fictional. Please play responsibly.

Progressive Difficulty
- Play against opponents that grow more challenging as you improve. Start with beginner-friendly rounds, then sharpen your strategy, memory, meld-building skills, and card play over time.

Jokers Add More Strategy

Leagues & Special Events
- Progress from Bronze to Silver and toward Legendary Master at your own pace. Complete special event goals and keep making progress with every game.

Personalized Card Table

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

TWO WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Play — choose your character and story, and the adventure begins
• Custom Game — create your own story, set the rules and build your world: write its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Custom Game, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.

apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

👉 Download the game for free. Your favourite word association is waiting.

📧 We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at support@quriousbit.com
